errors: On Linux/POSIX, process.stdout writes to pipes are asynchronous, not synchronous. Docker/Kubernetes commonly use pipes, so collector backpressure does not necessarily block the event loop synchronously.
Pino's standard asynchronous destinations and worker-thread transports offload output processing/I/O, but ordinary log-object serialization still happens on the main thread.
High event-loop delay alone does not prove logging is blocking; it indicates event-loop stalls whose cause must be established through profiling or comparison with logging disabled.
